_comment: The world map (DESIGN §5). Terrain and site placement are derived from a stable map seed, so the save stores only what the player has done. Sites whose resources do not exist yet (a quarry needs stone, a salt spring needs salt) wait for their content drop per §4.1 — banked, not dropped.

_proposed.radius: DESIGN §15.10 — map size is ❓ open. 12 gives 25 hexes across, the doc's proposal.

sites.name: Timber stand
sites.description: Standing oak within a day's haul.

sites.name: Clay bank
sites.description: A cut bank of good throwing clay.

sites.name: River meadow
sites.description: Flat ground the river floods and feeds.

sites.name: River ford
sites.description: A crossing the traders use. Holding it sharpens your rates.

sites.name: Old shrine
sites.description: A grove the tribes hold sacred. Rome's men are watched here.

sites.name: Ruins
sites.description: Older than Rome, and someone wrote things down.

sites.name: Barbarian camp
sites.description: Warriors, and they saw your scout first.

scout._comment: Prepared like an envoy (DESIGN §3.2): dispatched now, resolves at the next round.

hold._comment: Exposure rises with distance (DESIGN §5.3). A garrison is the only thing that answers it.
